q: A liquid exerts pressure because of its ____.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. A liquid exerts pressure because of its weight.
Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. The pressure depends on the depth.

q: Thus, the pressure exerted by the liquid at the bottom surface is ____.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. Thus, the pressure exerted by the liquid at the bottom surface is p = ρ g h.

q: It is seen therefore that the pressure ($p = \rho g h$) exerted by the liquid is directly proportional to the height (or) depth of the liquid $h$ and the ____.
e: In a static liquid, pressure rises with depth as ρgh. It is seen therefore that the pressure (p = ρ g h) exerted by the liquid is directly proportional to the height (or) depth of the liquid h and the density.

q: Although the weight of the liquid depends on its base area, the pressure exerted by the liquid is independent of the ____ (cross-sectional area).
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. Although the weight of the liquid depends on its base area, the pressure exerted by the liquid is independent of the base area (cross-sectional area).

q: The true pressure at the depth $h$ in the liquid will be, ____.
e: In a static liquid, pressure rises with depth as ρgh. The true pressure at the depth h in the liquid will be, p = patm + ρ g h.

q: The deeper the point inside the liquid the ____ is the pressure at that point.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. The deeper the point inside the liquid the greater is the pressure at that point.

q: The pressure in a liquid at a particular point acts ____ in all directions.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. The pressure in a liquid at a particular point acts equally in all directions.

q: Pressure at any point inside a liquid is the ____ in all directions.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. Pressure at any point inside a liquid is the same in all directions.

q: There will be pressure not only at the top of the body but also ____ pressure at the bottom of the body and lateral pressures at the sides of the body.
e: Fluid pressure comes from weight. A barometer reads that pressure as the height of a mercury column. There will be pressure not only at the top of the body but also upward pressure at the bottom of the body and lateral pressures at the sides of the body.

q: Liquids of the same density in containers all having the same height will exert the ____ pressure on their bases even though their weights and shapes are different.
e: Density is mass per unit volume, ρ = m/V. Liquids of the same density in containers all having the same height will exert the same pressure on their bases even though their weights and shapes are different. Same is what this sentence is naming.
